headline: Atlantaa independent director Meeta Arpan Brahmbhatt resigns effective October 2026
summary: Mrs. Meeta Arpan Brahmbhatt has submitted her resignation as Non-Executive Independent Director of Atlantaa, effective October 01, 2026.
